title.narrative: The Flipflopi Foundation- Integrated circular solutions for transportation: A community centered path to economic democracy
The Flipflopi Foundation- Integrated circular solutions for transportation: A community centered path to economic democracy

description.narrative: The purpose of the project is to revive indigenous circularity by integrating traditional boat-building knowledge with innovative plastic recycling techniques, demonstrating how circular systems can power viable local value chains. The objectives focus on unlocking economic opportunities for youth, in particular women and marginalized groups, by providing them with vocational training, busi-ness development skills, and access to cooperative structures and microfinance tools, creating new pathways to dignified employment and enterprise ownership. In addition, the project is designed to build technical capacity and catalyze innovation in design, manufacturing, and sustainable engineering. Participants will gain practical skills in working with recycled materials, electric propulsion systems, and alternative manufacturing methods that align with local environmental and economic realities. Finally, through a strong community engagement and education strategy, the project aims to raise awareness of plastic pollution as both an ecological crisis and a social justice issue to mobilize grassroots action to drive long-term behavior change and strengthen local stewardship of natural re-sources and inform policy. The Fliflopi Project Foundation will support 6 – 8 youth to establish a transport service cooperative, approximately 2,000 residents will benefit from safer and environmentally sustainable mode of maritime transportation, and approximately 4,000 people will be reached across through community awareness campaigns. From a systems change and policy perspective, the programme will contribute to lo-cal and national policy advocacy by generating evidence, best practices, and community-driven circular models that can inform more inclusive and sustainable waste management policies.
